needed.evidence: Informal path and narrow sidewalk under 1m, people walking in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous and usable sidewalk of at least 3 meters width along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian space.

needed.evidence: Obstruction on footway and partly blocked by vegetation or structures
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and clear the footway to ensure an unobstructed pedestrian path of at least 1m width on the right side.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections and trip hazards evident in the sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Resurface the sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure smooth walking conditions.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian presence and crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install marked pedestrian crossings at strategic points to facilitate safe crossing.

needed.evidence: Drivers may not stop; marked crossing is obstructed
needed.suggestion: Improve the visibility and safety of the marked crossing by including additional signs or traffic calming measures.

needed.evidence: Lack of dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Add kerb ramps at the crossing to ensure accessibility for pedestrians with prams, strollers, or mobility devices.
